notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on any creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes and Railway Brawler trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Servo you control.
Resolve the Railway Brawler trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Servo.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.
